newsitem.title: INDIA: India wants "big, dynamic" trade policy - minister.
newsitem.headline: India wants "big, dynamic" trade policy - minister.

text.p: Indian Commerce Minister Bolla Buli Ramaiah said on Friday that he wants to announce a "big, dynamic" trade policy by the end of March.

Ramaiah told a business conference in the Indian capital that he had already put a number of goods on Open General Licence (OGL), which permits them to be exported free of restriction, and Special Import Licence (SIL), which permits goods to be imported on a case by case basis.
"Now I want to come out with another big, dynamic policy by the end of this month," Ramaiah said without elaborating.
The government is scheduled to announce a new import-export policy by April 1.
